# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells His Children of His Illness

---

**26:1** And Adam called all his children to him and said: 'My sons and daughters, hear me. I am sick and in pain.'

**26:2** 'For many years I have borne the toil of the earth since the day I was expelled from paradise with your mother.'

**26:3** 'But now my strength fails me and the time of my death has come upon me.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
